title: acacia lentiscifolia
intro: Acacia lentiscifolia, commonly known as the Mastic Tree, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. The Mastic Tree has been traditionally used to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of indigestion, nausea, and diarrhea due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Acacia lentiscifolia include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
